svg.title: Cleany box pipeline state machine
svg.desc: State machine of scripts/run/box_states.py in three bands: SEE with YOLO26n and a frozen DINOv3 classifier, PICK with the act_dino policy, PLACE with fixed minimum-jerk moves. DROP uses the ESP32 doors. Every transition carries its condition and thresholds from config/box_pipeline.yaml.
svg.text: State machine of scripts/run/box_states.py, split by the model that does the work. Models only say what an item is and grasp it; everything else is fixed math.
front camera · YOLO26n finds items, DINOv3 says the material
act_dino policy grasps the item from the hover pose
no model: minimum-jerk moves between captured poses
[> 0.4 % of tray changed, or a YOLO box]
[> 0.4 % of tray changed, or a YOLO box]
[2nd drop in a row: retake empty-tray photo]
[2nd drop in a row: retake empty-tray photo]
doors report CLOSED (≤ 30 s), arm to home,
then 5 frames: photo of the empty tray
tray pixels vs empty photo (diff > 25, 4×4 blur);
gives up after 8 s (item keeps rolling)
6 settled frames: YOLO boxes (conf ≥ 0.25) by IoU
DINOv3 embeds each crop (+15 % pad), mean per item
k-NN: mean distance to 5 nearest crops per class
sortable if < 0.35 and 0.03 clear, else other
target: most free space; skip overlap / 3× failed
move to hover pose, gripper open (60 / 100)
policy drives the arm at 30 Hz (or scripted pose)
centre pose, then metal_bin or plastic_bin;
gripper held 3° past where it closed
gripper open, wait 1 s: item drops in its bin
move to home pose, ready for the next item
items fall into the mixed bin
no doors: clear tray by hand
1st press: arm torque off, move it by hand.
2nd press: arm stays where it was put,
goes home, and the state continues.
MODEL · TRAINED · used in WAIT and CLASSIFY
boxes only: its class label is ignored
MODEL · FROZEN, NOT TRAINED · used in CLASSIFY
box gallery not built yet; thresholds uncalibrated
MODEL · TRAINED (ACT layers only) · used in GRASP
chunk of 45 joint actions, temporal ens. 0.01
39 ms / step on RTX 2050 → about 25 Hz
not trained yet: needs hover-start dataset
NO MODEL · used in HOVER, CARRY, RELEASE, HOME
slip watched on every CARRY step
State colour = who does the work
[condition] = the transition fires when it holds; an arrow without one fires when the state's work is done. Chips name the models a state runs. Values from config/box_pipeline.yaml.
